At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Chemical Engineer (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

REQ ID: 204412

What you'll do

 * Lead the release and qualification of new chemicals based on customer requirements, ensuring alignment with design, safety, and process standards, with a strong emphasis on project management.

 * Evaluate and establish hardware operating limits related to chemical properties, including viscosity, concentration, temperature, and other relevant parameters.

 * Assess and verify the chemical resistance and compatibility of new and existing components when exposed to specified chemicals.

 * Analyze and consolidate technical data into trade-off studies and material selection matrices to support design and redesign decisions, including associated risk assessments.

 * Drive concept development and feasibility projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle.

Who we're looking for

 * Master's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related field with 3+ years of experience; or Bachelor's degree with 5+ years; or equivalent experience.

 * Academic background with a strong focus on project management, polymer and plastic materials, and laboratory-based research or testing.

Preferred Qualifications

 * Two or more years of experience in laboratory testing, chemical analysis, or a related technical environment.

 * Strong organizational and project coordination skills.

 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

 * Solid technical aptitude with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

 * Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

 * Experience in the semiconductor industry is highly desirable.

What We're Offering

1 Communications Specialist (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500
REQ ID: 203696

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Focus Distribution 

 * PR and external communications experience (approximately 40%) 
 * Event and visit support (approximately 30%)
 * Internal and employee communications support, including Social Impact activities (approximately 20%)
 * Photo and video production (approximately 10%) 

1. External Communications and PR (~40%) 

 * Manage day-to-day coordination with PR agencies, local and regional media, photographers, media partners, print suppliers and event service providers. 
 * Support press spokespersons: prepare briefing documents, align key messages, and handle media follow-ups.
 * Draft, proofread and quality-check PR and communications materials in German and English (press releases, subtitles, media briefings and event materials)
 * Produce media materials, briefing sheets, coverage reports, summaries and follow-up notes in English. 

2. Event and Visit Support (~30%) 

 * Plan and support site events, visits and media-related activities at the Austrian sites, including examples such as executive visits, government visits, and official delegations, with support for protocol, agendas, briefing packs, site logistics and on-the-day coordination. 
 * Coordinate corporate events and trade fair participation: venues, suppliers, local partners, shipping and receiving of materials.
 * Manage schedules and meeting arrangements for event-related activities, including PR moments, media visits, executive engagements and government-related meetings. 

3. Internal and Employee Communications (~20%) 

 * Develop and publish PR-relevant content on the intranet and internal social platforms. 
 * Prepare internal announcements supporting PR activities, media visits, executive communications and site events.
 * Deliver employee communications for Social Impact activities in Austria, including coordination with NGO and community partners. 

4. Photo and Video Production (~10%) 

 * Capture or commission photography and video at site events, visits and Social Impact activities. 
 * Edit video content for internal and external channels
 * Select, crop and lay out photography for internal and external communications use. 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 * Completed education (College or Bachelor) in the field of Business, Marketing or Communication 
 * Minimum four years of experience in public relations, external communications, media relations, corporate communications, marketing communications or event support
 * Native German speaker with professional working proficiency in English, spoken and written, with the ability to write and proofread press materials, announcement emails, short articles and briefing documents in both languages
 * Demonstrated video editing ability, with a portfolio or work samples. Working knowledge of a standard editing suite and basic photo editing
 * Proficiency with Microsoft Office: Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint, Teams and Excel, and comfort working in English-language tool interfaces.
 * On-site presence three days per week
 * Strong self-management: able to prioritise, sequence and deliver without close supervision
 * Organised and detail-oriented, particularly under event-day pressure
 * Strong communicator and genuine team player across sites and functions
 * Flexible and comfortable with shifting priorities

WHAT YOU WILL DO
 * Act as an interface to regional Quality Program Leaders (QPLs) and Functional Quality Managers (FQMs) within a global quality network.
 * Monitor quality performance and incoming quality records, and report performance against defined quality objectives.
 * Drive quality investigations and improvement decisions in a cross-functional team environment.

 * Act as a quality mentor and coach for Quality Case Owners (QCOs).

We are looking for an enthusiastic Quality Engineer who is passionate about continuous improvement and committed to strengthening the quality of our products and systems. The ideal candidate is motivated by evolving technology, increasing customer expectations, and the opportunity to contribute to an interdisciplinary global quality network. You bring a structured problem-solving mindset, strong collaboration skills, and the drive to turn quality insights into sustainable improvements.

 * +5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 3 years and a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.
 * Technical background in semiconductor equipment, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field.
 * Fundamental understanding of quality management systems (QMS) and experience applying quality standards and processes.
 * Experience with quality methods such as 8D, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, FMEA, or similar problem-solving approaches.
 * Project management capabilities and the ability to lead cross-functional improvement activities.
 * Strong data analysis capabilities, including data mining, trend analysis, interpretation of quality metrics, and translation of findings into actionable conclusions.
 * Fluent English skills are required; German language skills are beneficial.
 * Quality certifications such as Six Sigma Green Belt, Six Sigma Black Belt, or equivalent are a plus.

jobs.description:
As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial contributions to solving the major challenges of our time, climate change and digitalisation. To achieve our goals, we rely on our specific research, development and technology competencies, which are the basis of our commitment to excellence in all areas. With our open culture of innovation and our motivated, international teams, we are working to position AIT as Austria's leading research institution at the highest international level and to make a positive contribution to the economy and society.

The Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is looking for new Ingenious Partners for our location in Vienna. Our Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is a think tank in national and international research and innovation networks, and it is a key partner for public administration, companies, universities, and research institutions.

The Com... 1 Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle" - JOB ID: 269966  * For this master's thesis you will investigate extensive time series of driving dynamics obtained from multiple motorcycle rides by multiple riders on given tracks.
 * You will support us in working out characteristic features in driving dynamics that differentiate the different riders.
 * You will investigate the possibility of using simulation software (like IPG Motorcycle maker) to use the obtained data for setting up simulations of motorcycle movements.

 * Under the guidance of our researchers, you will implement model building approaches to extract characterizing features from motorcyclist data.
 * With the support of our team, you will investigate the feasibility of simulating driver movements based on the characterizing features extracted before.
 * You will explore different model-building approaches and criteria for selecting the most appropriate one with the guidance of our researchers.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Ongoing master's studies in the field of Technical Mathematics at TU Vienna
 * Good knowledge in R, Python, or MATLAB, willingness to adopt multiple of these languages as needed
 * Enjoyment of application-oriented questions of industry
 * High level of commitment and team spirit
 * English or German skills commensurate with the role - The thesis can be completed in either language

 

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: as soon as possible, with some flexibility depending on your availability
 * EUR 1273 gross per month for 20 hours/week based on the collective agreement.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
